standard.summary: 把池化后的文本条件送进 AdaLN 调制信号的储备路线：一个零初始化的投影器给 shift / scale 加条件相关的增量。当前只做到 seam 接线。
standard.effect: method=none 或没有已发布的池化文本时是默认路径；开启且拿到池化文本才真的加增量。零初始化保证起点等价，门控本身不动；配套的蒸馏 loss 在关闭时等于基线、开启时加一项真实反传项。
standard.whenToUse: 验证「调制信号能否被 prompt 直接调制」这一假设时，用本地探针观察增量与蒸馏项是否真的在学。
standard.avoidWhen: 常规训练里不要开——运行时激活仍被闸住，底模的 llm_adapter / timestep_embed / adaln_modulation 也不会被改写，别指望它改变输出。

standard_en.summary: A reserve route that feeds pooled text conditioning into the AdaLN modulation signal: a zero-initialised projector adds prompt-conditioned deltas to shift / scale. Only the seam is wired today.
standard_en.effect: With method=none, or without published pooled text, it is the default path; the deltas are only added when enabled and pooled text is available. Zero initialisation keeps the starting point equivalent, the gate is untouched, and the paired distill loss equals the baseline when off while adding one real backprop term when on.
standard_en.whenToUse: To test the hypothesis that the modulation signal can be driven directly by the prompt, watching through a local probe whether the delta and the distill term actually learn.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not turn it on in ordinary training -- runtime activation is still gated and the base model's llm_adapter / timestep_embed / adaln_modulation are never rewritten, so do not expect the output to change.

advanced.principle: modulation_guidance_reserve_seam 里的 PooledTextModulationProjector 零初始化，输出作为 shift / scale 的增量叠加到 AdaLN 上；底模参数只读不改。价值验证记录为 8/8 + 15 个单测 + 真权重探针（85 个注入点，投影器从 0 训到 0.107，蒸馏项 0.062→0.0013，默认路径与 remove 后逐位一致）。
advanced.intervention: AdaLN 调制信号的加法分支，与常量偏置的 adaln_guidance 是两条不同的路线。
advanced.expectedImpact: 目前无可宣称的训练收益，探针只证明它有学习能力且不破坏默认路径。
advanced.tradeoffs: 与 adaln_guidance 容易混淆：那条改的是常量偏置，这条改的是条件相关的增量；两者同时开启时效果不叠加也不抵消，需分别验证。

advanced_en.principle: The PooledTextModulationProjector in modulation_guidance_reserve_seam is zero-initialised and its output is added to the AdaLN shift / scale as a delta; base-model parameters are read-only. Evidence is 8/8 plus 15 unit tests plus a real-weights probe (85 injection sites, projector trained 0 to 0.107, distill term 0.062 to 0.0013, default path and post-remove bitwise identical).
advanced_en.intervention: An additive branch on the AdaLN modulation signal; a different route from the constant-bias adaln_guidance.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: No claimable training benefit today; the probe only shows it can learn and leaves the default path intact.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Easy to confuse with adaln_guidance: that one changes a constant bias, this one a conditioning-dependent delta. With both on the effects neither stack nor cancel, so each needs separate validation.
